visualization.name: SmilesDrawer
visualization.description: Visualize molecular structures from SMILES notation
visualization.help:
# What is SmilesDrawer?
SmilesDrawer renders **2D structure diagrams** of molecules written in SMILES (Simplified Molecular Input Line Entry System) notation, directly in your browser.
After selecting a `smi` dataset, every molecule is drawn as a structure card labelled with its name and SMILES string. Each line of the dataset holds one SMILES string, optionally followed by whitespace and a molecule name; lines starting with `#` are skipped.
## Key Features
- **Structure Grid**: The grid fits the window, choosing the column count automatically; datasets with more molecules than fit are split into pages. - **Search**: Filter molecules by name or SMILES substring. - **Themes**: Switch between SmilesDrawer's color themes, including dark ones. - **Error Marking**: Lines that cannot be parsed as SMILES are shown as such instead of being dropped.
To learn more about SmilesDrawer, visit: [https://github.com/reymond-group/smilesDrawer](https://github.com/reymond-group/smilesDrawer)
